title: Risk Mitigation Update
summary: A small equity reduction responds to speculative sentiment.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: The action reduces equity beta but carries opportunity cost and short-duration rate risk. The author explicitly disclaims a short-term forecast and gives no reversal date; performance cannot be judged from whichever later window looks favorable.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.
claims.next_check: Link the next allocation change and reconstruct the full 5% sleeve with distributions.

claims.reason: The ratio measures traded contract counts, not necessarily directional net buying. Calls can be sold or hedged and institutional/index versus equity options differ. The stated decade low needs the exact series and dated CBOE data.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Identify total/equity/index ratio, smoothing and buy-to-open treatment.

claims.reason: A contrarian relationship needs a fixed threshold, horizon and false-positive test. Very bullish sentiment can persist; the source itself recognizes this limitation rather than promises an immediate drop.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Bankrupt shares can lose all value
claims.reason: Equity is junior to creditors, but bankruptcy does not mechanically imply zero recovery. The article does not identify its basket; company-level reorganization outcomes are needed before judging the very-likely-zero claim.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Identify referenced issuers and inspect confirmed recovery plans, including exceptions such as improved enterprise value.

claims.claim: Crowded bearish expectations can delay corrections
claims.reason: No measurable professional-positioning threshold or delay is specified. This is a caution about a trade's popularity, not a separately falsifiable market forecast.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

framework_lessons: Risk reduction need not require predicting the next day.
assessment: This is a modest allocation change, not an explicit crash forecast. A fair audit must follow the cash sleeve until its next documented change and distinguish options volume from net directional exposure.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
